node_definition.done_when: tests/test_the_review_store_is_indexed_by_its_writers.py runs, on a temporary crew home, a review store of at least 500 records across 50 runs, and shows five things. A record stored through store_review is returned by a lookup of its run id in the index, with no listing of the store. Reading every run's records after that store, through the station's refresh with a per-tick review store installed, makes no stat or listing of the store directory, counted through a recording stand-in for os.stat, os.scandir and Path.glob on that directory. The changed-run query since the prior version names exactly the run written, and that run's digest changes while every other run's does not. A record written directly to the directory, bypassing the writer, is found on the next read by one listing of names, with no stat of existing records. A missing index is rebuilt from one listing. A record stored by a second process with its own in-memory state, standing in for another node, is returned to the first process's next lookup. Negative control: at the base revision the reads after a store stat every record in the store. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against base in matched arms run as an all_debug partition job, submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch and never on the fleet node. Each arm's log sits under the run directory, opens with its revision and literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths. After the node lands and the station reloads, the coordinator records one per-project-refresh duration from the station's own stage timing.
